caseName: United Jewish Organizations of Williamsburgh, Inc. v. Carey
caseNameFull: United Jewish Organizations of Williamsburgh, Inc. v. Carey, Governor of New York

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 945.] Motion of Board for Legal Assistance to the-Jewish Poor, Inc., et al., for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
